description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ContentBoxesController' that manages content box entities within an admin web interface. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, viewing details, and saving content boxes, handling associated content and descriptions, and rendering relevant views.

classes.name: ContentBoxesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations for content boxes in the admin interface.

methods.name: listContentBoxes
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all content boxes, sets menu and model attributes.

methods.name: createBox
methods.description: Handles GET request to initialize and show the form for creating a new content box, including setting default descriptions and positions.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET request to show details of a specific content box by ID, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a content box, including validation, setting related descriptions, and persistence.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper to set the navigation menu context within the model.
